prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — it depends on what you need (brand building vs. performance marketing), your budget, industry, and whether you need local, regional or global reach.

Two KC agencies that are widely recognized and worth considering:
- VMLY&R (formerly VML) — large, full‑service global agency with strong digital/experience capabilities and enterprise clients. Good for national or global campaigns and integrated work.
- Barkley — a highly regarded independent creative agency based in KC, known for strong branding and creative campaigns.

If you tell me:
- Your budget range
- Business size (startup, SMB, enterprise)
- Primary goals (brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce growth, SEO/ads, social content)
- Industry (B2B, healthcare, consumer, retail, etc.)

I’ll shortlist 4–6 Kansas City agencies that match and include why each is a fit plus questions to ask them. If you want to research on your own first, check review sites (Clutch, Ad Age lists), ask for local referrals, and evaluate candidates on case studies, measurable results, team makeup, and references.
